title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 81
paragraphs: These were the nations that served in the land campaign and had been assigned to the infantry. Of this army the men mentioned above were the commanders; they were the ones who drew it up in divisions, counted it, and appointed commanders of thousands and commanders of ten thousands. The commanders of hundreds and of tens were appointed by the commanders of ten thousands; and there were others who led divisions and nations.
